brief: Goldman's daily cross-asset market colour for Monday 26 Oct. US equities rose (SPX +70bps to 7676, NDX +109bps, RTY +38bps) while Brazil's EWZ fell 20% (worst outside COVID) and BRL -9% after Lula's election win. AI-trade breadth stabilized (GS Data Center and AI Semis baskets +2.6%/+2.5%), though GS flow notes the recent bounce reflects cessation of selling pressure rather than active buying. EU Defense/Semis and French Banks (on Moody's relief) also bid. Dark pools have gained US equities market share since 2024 while OTC share has slipped. GS stays modestly pro-risk (OW equities, UW credit, OW cash 3m, OW bonds 12m): earnings support, lighter positioning and lower valuations should help equities into year-end against AI, Middle East and midterm-election risks. Macro: AI's growing labor-market effects plus moderating inflation lead GS to expect fewer DM central-bank rate hikes than priced. Single names: Gjensidige cut to Neutral (EPS cut 2.4%) as margin expansion slows; Wartsila beat on orders, Energy-driven; Allianz estimated below consensus on P&C ahead of its Nov 12 print; Orange beat and raised; Apple (Buy) seen in-line next quarter.
